description: This file defines structures, constants, and inline functions for DNS message packing and unpacking, including handling DNS headers, questions, resource records, and specific functions for mDNS and LLMNR.

methods.name: dns_msg_pack_qname
methods.description: Packs a domain name into DNS message format, converting a string like www.example.com into label format.

methods.name: dns_unpack_answer
methods.description: Unpacks a DNS answer message to extract resource record data.

methods.name: dns_unpack_response_header
methods.description: Unpacks the DNS response header, verifying transaction ID and response validity.

methods.name: dns_msg_pack_query
methods.description: Constructs a DNS query message with specified parameters.

methods.name: dns_unpack_response_query
methods.description: Unpacks the query section of a DNS response to determine answer offset and validate QTYPE and QCLASS.

methods.name: dns_copy_qname
methods.description: Copies a possibly compressed QNAME from a DNS message buffer into a linear buffer, removing compression pointers.

methods.name: mdns_unpack_query_header
methods.description: Unpacks mDNS query header, skipping certain checks as per RFC 6762.

methods.name: dns_unpack_query
methods.description: Unpacks a DNS query from a message buffer, extracting QTYPE and QCLASS.
